tool_calls.input:
const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/repair_w45_validate.py
+import hashlib
+import json
+import subprocess
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
+from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
+from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
+
+
+root = Path.cwd()
+worktree_bytes = (root / "tome-orcs.lua").read_bytes()
+head_bytes = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "HEAD:tome-orcs.lua"], cwd=root)
+manifest = load_manifest()
+loader = LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))
+head = loader.load_bytes(head_bytes, logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations
+worktree = loader.load_bytes(worktree_bytes, logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations
+assert len(head) == len(worktree) == 3904, (len(head), len(worktree))
+
+changed = []
+for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(head, worktree)):
+    before_other = {key: value for key, value in before.items() if key != "target"}
+    after_other = {key: value for key, value in after.items() if key != "target"}
+    assert before_other == after_other, (index, before_other, after_other)
+    if before["target"] != after["target"]:
+        changed.append((index, before, after))
+assert len(changed) == 27, len(changed)
+
+workset = json.loads(
+    (root / ".ai/task/repair-w45-20260927/WORKSET.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+)["items"]
+assert len(workset) == 27
+for item in workset:
+    matches = [
+        row
+        for _, row, _ in changed
+        if row.get("section") == item["section"]
+        and row.get("source") == item["source"]
+        and row.get("source_tag") == item["source_tag"]
+        and row.get("args_order") == item.get("args_order")
+        and row.get("target") == item["target_preimage"]
+    ]
+    assert len(matches) == 1, (item["entry_revision_identity"], len(matches))
+
+key = "e49260a92e51ee71a2eb596d9302d4872ad606000990d4a13bc1262a57173541"
+item = next(row for row in workset if row["entry_revision_identity"] == key)
+target_matches = [
+    after["target"]
+    for _, before, after in changed
+    if before.get("section") == item["section"]
+    and before.get("source") == item["source"]
+    and before.get("source_tag") == item["source_tag"]
+]
+assert target_matches == [
+    "允许你制造 %d 等级的电子蒸汽工具。\n"
+    "\t\t你将在 1 级时学会一个新配方。\n"
+    "\t\t此后每升一级，你有 20%% 的概率再学会一个随机配方；如果到 5 级仍未学会，则必定学会一个（除非已学会全部配方）。\n"
+    "\t\t%s"
+], target_matches
+
+old = "允许你制造 %d 等级的电子道具。".encode()
+new = "允许你制造 %d 等级的电子蒸汽工具。".encode()
+assert worktree_bytes.count(new) == 1
+assert worktree_bytes.count(old) == 0
+reconstructed = worktree_bytes.replace(new, old)
+prior_sha = json.loads(
+    (root / "evidence/quality/repair-window-45-20260927/VALIDATION.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+)["translation_file_sha256"]
+assert hashlib.sha256(reconstructed).hexdigest() == prior_sha
+
+print(
+    json.dumps(
+        {
+            "records_total": len(worktree),
+            "changed_targets": len(changed),
+            "changed_set_exact": True,
+            "non_target_fields_unchanged": True,
+            "e492_target_exact": True,
+            "single_edit_since_prior_validation": True,
+            "worktree_sha256": hashlib.sha256(worktree_bytes).hexdigest(),
+        },
+        ensure_ascii=False,
+        sort_keys=True,
+    )
+)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
